map.《中国图书馆分类法》设 22 个基本大类，用字母（A-Z，其中 I、O、U、V、: The Chinese Library Classification has 22 basic classes indicated by letters (A-Z, with I, O, U, V, W, X and Y unused): A Marxism-Leninism, B philosophy and religion, C social sciences general, D politics and law, T industrial technology (TP computing) ... Z general books. Each class then divides into second and third level categories.

map.主题检索辅助：读者用关键词（如「心理学」）搜索，工具在类目名与类号中模糊匹配，返: Subject search aid: readers search by keyword (such as "psychology") and the tool fuzzy-matches against class names and class numbers, returning candidate classes to help locate the shelf area fast.
map.分类号与索书号有什么区别？: What is the difference between a classification number and a call number?
map.分类号（如 TP3）只表示主题归属；索书号 = 分类号 + 著者号/种次号（如: The classification number (such as TP3) only indicates the subject; the call number = classification number + author number/sequence number (such as TP3/123), which uniquely identifies one book among the same class and is the practical basis for shelving and retrieval.
map.示例：检索「计算机」与「心理学」定位类号: Example: search "computer" and "psychology" to locate class numbers
map.索书号补全：拿到分类号后还需加著者号/种次号才能上架，本工具提示附加规则（如 T: Call number completion: after getting the classification number you still need the author/sequence number before shelving. This tool explains the extra rules (such as TP3/123 or TP3/W285) so you can write the call number directly.
map.编目员查类目：新书到馆按主题在 22 个基本大类（A 马克思主义 → Z 综合性: For cataloguers: when a new book arrives, locate the first-level class among the 22 basic classes (A Marxism-Leninism → Z general books) by subject, then drill down to second-level classes to get a number such as "TP3 computing technology".
map.输入图书或主题关键词，在中国图书馆分类法（CLC）中匹配对应的分类号与类名，并列: Enter a book or subject keyword and match the classification number and class name in the Chinese Library Classification (CLC), listing related parent and child classes to assist cataloguing and shelving.
